title: Étale-local product splitting of integral algebras with finite fibres and finite separable residue extensions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof first captures every separable residue-field generator in a finite subalgebra while preserving distinct fibre primes. Étale splitting of that finite subalgebra must then be transferred to the original integral algebra, removing the unwanted summand without losing the purely inseparable residue-field condition.
